description: This file implements utility functions for extracting tensor dimension sizes within the Metal backend of the ATen library, which is part of PyTorch. It defines functions to determine batch size, channel size, height, and width based on tensor dimensions.

methods.name: batchSize
methods.description: Returns the batch size of the tensor based on its dimensions, defaulting to 1 if dimension count is less than 4.

methods.name: channelsSize
methods.description: Returns the channels size of the tensor, defaulting to 1 if dimension count is less than 3.

methods.name: heightSize
methods.description: Returns the height size of the tensor, defaulting to 1 if dimension count is less than 2.

methods.name: widthSize
methods.description: Returns the width size of the tensor, defaulting to 1 if dimension count is less than 1.
